build_flatlogprobs_container: build a FlatLogprobs container to efficiently store token logprobs with reduced GC overhead
create_prompt_logprobs: create a prompt logprobs container for a request, optionally using the flat optimized format
create_sample_logprobs: create a sample logprobs container for storing decode-time logprobs of a request
append_logprobs_for_next_position: append logprobs for the next generation position into a prompt or sample logprobs container
build_logprob_dataclass: build a Logprob dataclass instance with logprob value, vocab rank, and decoded token string
